title: Apply volume discount to order totals
body:
Orders of 100 units or more should get the volume discount applied to the order total. Right now the total ignores it.

Acceptance criteria:
- An order of 100 units or more has the volume discount applied
- An order under 100 units is unchanged
- The discounted total appears on the order summary

comments.body: The discount percentages are already configured, so this is about calling the calculation from the total, not about defining new rates.
